description: The CosmopolIC 2.1 V4 product is a highly secure and powerful multi-application Java Card platform for smart cards. The product is fully interoperable and complies with JavaCard 2.1.1 and Open Platform 2.0.1 standards. It supports both T=0 and T=1 protocols, DES, 3DES, SHA, RSA signature and key generation up to 2048 bits.
